scenario: Agent1 and Agent2 are both regulars at the same local gym. They are acquaintances who often see each other during workouts. Today, Agent1 notices that Agent2 doesn't wipe down the machines after use, which is against the gym's hygiene rules and common courtesy.
learner_goal: Politely remind Agent2 about the importance of wiping down the machines after use for the sake of everyone's health and the gym's cleanliness. (<extra_info>Extra information: Agent1 has observed several people being uncomfortable with the situation but no one has addressed it yet</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Liam Johnson
transcript.content: Morning, Jaxon. Quick favor — could you wipe down the machines after you use them? A few people have been getting uncomfortable and the gym asks we do it; it really helps keep everyone healthy. Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Jaxon Prentice
transcript.content: Morning, Liam — sorry about that, my mistake. I got distracted this morning and forgot to wipe them; I'll clean the machines now and make sure it doesn't happen again. Thanks for the heads-up.
